scientific.integrity: The coefficient is obtained from an explicit matrix-exponential expansion at the continuous switch and replayed by a standalone standard-library verifier. The source and closest general sampled-data and bang-bang discretization papers were compared at the statement level; equivalence under different switching-quantization terminology remains a residual risk.
scientific.limitations: The theorem is local to the three-block endpoint branch and does not establish global sampled-data optimality for every N. Uniform asymptotics are asserted only for fractional switch phases in compact subsets of the open unit interval, with exact alignment handled separately.

title: Cubic grid-phase law for a sampled bang switch in a controlled qubit
